messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

The dose is then 75 mg orally once a day thereafter.

The relation 'has dose increment interval' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug's dose increments should occur at intervals of no less than the time specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has dose increase': The subject drug may have a specified increment in dose, as specified by the object entity.
B. 'has dose increment': The subject drug's dose is increased by the specified amount at regular intervals.
C. 'has dose limitation': The subject drug has a restriction on the dose specified by the object entity.
D. 'has duration of treatment': The subject drug is typically taken for the length of time specified by the object entity.
